_archive: V2 state archived to .harness/state-v2-archive.json. V2 final: D1=0.72 D3=0.31 (n=50), JIRA injection brought D3=0.35 on n=20.
vision: Build a plan-driven bug attribution agent with internal governance. The system separates concerns into three pipelines: (1) Input Pipeline — deterministic extraction and candidate retrieval at zero LLM cost; (2) Agent Pipeline — LLM plans, examines, and attributes within an InvestigationBrief, governed by an investigation harness with rules and skills; (3) Evaluation Pipeline — oracle scores output. The agent receives a CandidateSet (not raw repo access), operates within completion criteria (not just budget), produces structured InvestigationTraces for learning, and improves over time via skills derived from traces. Evaluated via Hit@k, MRR, D3, D6, and Retrieval Recall against ApacheJIT ground truth.
direction: ARCHITECTURE V4: Build the three-pipeline system. All research spikes and ADRs complete (topology-debate, mechanism-design, retrieval-spike). Build pipeline: P1 core models → P2/P3 governance+retrieval (parallel) → P4/P5 assembler+input (parallel) → P6 harness → P7 trace+eval. Optional P8: Level 2 extractor.

invariants.temporal_bound: Temporal bound (COMMIT_B~1) constrains the ENTIRE system — input pipeline retrieval and agent tools. In eval mode, bound comes from fix_hash. In production mode (future), from bug report date or HEAD.
invariants.llm_reasons_scripts_retrieve: Scripts own retrieval (candidate set assembly) and evidence verification. LLM owns planning, examination reasoning, and attribution. The LLM never searches from scratch — it receives a curated CandidateSet.
invariants.agent_is_governed: The investigation harness governs the LLM. The LLM does not self-govern. The harness manages state, transitions, and completion criteria. Budget is a hard stop, not the primary exit signal.
invariants.observable_by_design: Every investigation produces a structured InvestigationTrace. No investigation is a black box. Traces are the substrate for skill emergence.
invariants.ground_truth: GroundTruthGraph provides bug_hash from commit_links.csv. SZZ-based labeling has known noise -- Hit@5 is primary metric, not Hit@1.

tasks.name: V4 build: PromptAssembler — 10-section ordered template with truncation policy
tasks.scope: commit_investigator/governance/prompt_assembler.py: assemble(stage, problem_statement, candidate_set, investigation_state, brief, evidence) producing ordered sections per mechanism-design ADR §Q3. Truncation at 80% token budget (evidence → candidates → skills). Stage-specific candidate formatting (top 20 for Stage 2; examined + next 5 for Stage 3). Tests with fixture data verifying section order, empty-section omission, and truncation behavior.

tasks.name: V4 build: input pipeline entry — Stage 0 extraction + Stage 1 retrieval wired
tasks.scope: commit_investigator/retrieval/pipeline.py: prepare_investigation(problem, repo, temporal_bound) → (ProblemStatement, CandidateSet). Reuses existing ProblemExtractor for Stage 0. Brief-validation retry path: re-run Stage 1 with widened retrieval (mechanism-design ADR §Q6). CLI smoke script or pytest proving end-to-end input for one eval case. Zero LLM cost.

tasks.name: V4 checkpoint: Retrieval Recall@100 on n=20 eval cases
tasks.scope: Run production retrieval (input pipeline) on all 20 seed=42 eval cases. Measure Retrieval Recall@100 per case and aggregate. Compare to spike baseline (0.45). Report per-strategy contribution breakdown. Write results to results/v4-checkpoints/retrieval-recall.json.
tasks.note: Early kill switch. If production retrieval underperforms the spike, diagnose before building harness on top. Gate=0.35 (spike ADR), target=0.45 (spike combined result).

tasks.name: V4 build: investigation harness — state machine, brief validator, completion criteria, scoped tools
tasks.scope: New commit_investigator/harness/ package: InvestigationHarness orchestrating Stages 2→3→4. BriefValidator (min 2 hypotheses, 1 retry, default brief fallback per ADR §Q6). CompletionCriteria evaluator after each Stage 3 turn (evidence=3, hypotheses=2, confidence=0.60, max_effort=18). Re-plan loop max 2. Hard-rule enforcement at transitions. Stage 3 tools scoped to CandidateSet. Refactor or wrap existing orchestrator LLM calls behind harness interface. Tests with MockLLMProvider for stage transitions, validation failures, degraded mode.
tasks.note: Core agent pipeline. Replaces V3 self-governed loop.

tasks.name: V4 build: trace writer + run_eval integration — V4 path with Retrieval Recall metric
tasks.scope: TraceWriter: JSON InvestigationTrace per investigation at results/traces/{issue_key}/{run_id}.json with per-turn Stage 3 granularity (ADR §Q4). Wire V4 harness into eval/run_eval.py behind --agent-version v4 (or env flag); V3 path preserved for baseline comparison. Attach investigation_trace to BugAttributionReport. Compute Retrieval Recall (ground truth in top 100). Smoke eval on 1–3 cases then n=20 comparison vs V3 baselines.
